thread:
maya: Quick sync — planning to enable ff.microseg_v2 for a micro-segment tonight during the 10pm-2am window. goal: validate audience isolation and SLO override logic before broader slice. PTAL on scope below.
kevin: scope? how big is the micro-seg and what metric guardrails are we using?
aditya: proposed audience = 0.5% orgs (random org-level assignment) + 1% of users in orgs for churny customers. primary metric = served-success-rate (SSR) and downstream completion CTR. Stop rule: if SSR drops by >2% (absolute) vs baseline with p<0.01 over any 30m window, auto-disable.
sarah: also add error-rate spike stop: >1.5x baseline error-rate for 15m. if triggered, we should auto-roll to fallback model and page oncall.
maya: yes — full list below. also need a quick code-review for the rollout flag gating change (PR #4021). can someone pick it up? ci-bot: build passed for 4021, unit tests 81/81.
kevin: i'll do CR now, pinging in PR. main change is the override priority: rollout > org-override > user-override. want to confirm ordering.
aditya: ordering makes sense for experiments but ensure audit log records which rule served the decision. we need that for postmortem if something leaks.
maya: good call — add audit field ff_decision_source.
kevin: in PR, added ff_decision_source and a small opt-in for verbose logging (env var MICROSEG_VERBOSE=true). also added a metric tag 'segment=microseg_v2'.
sarah: monitoring: I've created a short dashboard widget pinned to the rollout page: /dashboards/rollouts/microseg_v2 — tracks SSR, latency p95, error-rate, and traffic-entropy (to detect audience leakage). link: https://internal.prod/dashboards/microseg_v2
aditya: experiment-bot: please schedule the AB run: audience split config:
```
{ "experiment_id": "exp_microseg_v2_2026_09_07", "variants": { "control": 99.5, "microseg_v2": 0.5 }, "metrics": ["SSR","CTR","latency_p95"], "stop_rules": [ {"metric":"SSR","threshold":-2.0,"window_mins":30,"p_value":0.01}, {"metric":"error_rate","multiplier":1.5,"window_mins":15} ] }
```
experiment-bot: scheduled exp_microseg_v2_2026_09_07 to start 2026-09-07T02:00:00Z. Traffic ramp: instant (small seed), monitor 30m then consider scaling to 5% orgs if stable.
maya: deploy plan: 1) enable flag in staging for smoke 2) enable in prod for seed orgs (0.5%) 3) monitor dashboard 4) after 30m no alerts, keep for 2h then expand to 5% orgs 5) if any stop rule fires, rollback flag and notify #incidents.
kevin: small note — the seed uses a hash on org_id + salt. make sure salt rotation is consistent between canaries to avoid reseeding same orgs. PR updated.
aditya: also please run leakage check: sample logs for 1000 requests and compute user-id distribution entropy. if entropy < expected threshold, abort.
maya: who will run the smoke at staging? kevin?
kevin: yep I'll kick off staging smoke at 20:30 PT. will post results here.
sarah: oncall FYI — i'm subscribed to alerts for that dash; if paging threshold hit I'll page per playbook.
maya: thanks all. quick asks: @kevin PTAL PR #4021 (blocking), @aditya can you confirm experiment-bot config matches our analytics schema? @sarah confirm paging thresholds set.
kevin: LGTM on PR, left one nits (non-blocking). will merge after green e2e.
aditya: config maps to schema, only note: CTR needs censoring for PII — our aggregator should hash identifiers before joining. I added a note in the experiment config.
experiment-bot: exp_microseg_v2_2026_09_07: integrity check passed (schema + metric mapping). Start window open.
maya: perfect. if no objections i'll proceed with the staging enable at 20:30 PT.
kevin: no objections from eng.
sarah: SRE clear.
aditya: go for it.
maya: starting staging smoke now — will post a short dump in 10m.
kevin: merged PR #4021, deploy pipeline kicked.
ci-bot: deploy to staging pipeline succeeded for commit d4c3b2.
maya: quick staging results: smoke OK, SSR no change, latency within baseline. snapshot: 10m sample looks clean. will proceed to prod seed at 22:00 PT.
aditya: monitoring configured. will run entropy/lk checks during first 30m and post a note if something odd.
sarah: alert thresholds copied to the microseg channel and tied to the rollout dash.
maya: thanks team. tagging follow-ups: - post-experiment analysis (aditya) - add audit log extractor to infra (kevin) - bake canary KB doc (maya)
kevin: noted. I'll add extractor work to next sprint.
aditya: i'll own the analysis and share a quick report 24h after full rollout.
maya: closing the loop here — will update the rollout page with final status once expanded. :rocket:
experiment-bot: exp_microseg_v2_2026_09_07: seed completed, 0.5% orgs rolling in. Monitoring active.
sarah: received — oncall standing by.
maya: thread archived once the analysis is posted. thanks!
